name: Fuel additive
description: Remember to add fuel additive: after a number of kilometres or after a number of refuels - you choose, and only if you want it.
author: Matze89x

de.name: Kraftstoff-Additiv
de.description: Erinnert ans Additiv: nach einer Anzahl Kilometer oder nach einer Anzahl Tankungen – du wählst, und nur, wenn du es willst.

settings.label: Remind me
settings.help: Without a tank level (the car does not report refuelling) kilometres fit best; if refuels are logged, counting refuels does.

de.label: Erinnern
de.help: Ohne Tankanzeige (das Auto meldet kein Tanken) passen Kilometer am besten; werden Tankungen erfasst, passt das Zählen der Tankungen.

settings.label: After ... refuels
settings.help: For example 2: the reminder comes with the second refuel.

de.label: Nach ... Tankungen
de.help: Zum Beispiel 2: Die Erinnerung kommt bei der zweiten Tankung.

reminders.title: Add fuel additive
reminders.text_due: Add the additive at the next refuel.

docs: Reminds you to add fuel additive after a number of kilometres or refuels (default every 1000 km; 2000 or 3000 can be chosen). Optional and off by default. Shows on Home and the fuel page; a refuel can also count.
